escenas.texto: Supercars, Formula One in Las Vegas, a Bugatti that won't behave, and one game that took over the conversation all across Europe. This week, a creator with five thousand subscribers sat on the same list as creators with over twenty million. And at the very top? A name you probably won't guess. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Europe edition. Today we count down the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the very end, because every number one has a surprise.

Quick rules before we start. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Europe. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes straight from the official YouTube API, and the weekly cut is every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Ready? Let's go.
First list: the ten most viewed. Opening the countdown at number ten, from Spain, Dagar, with a Minecraft adventure over twenty-five minutes long. Over five point seven million views.
Number nine, PORTIA AI STORY LITH, with an AI story of just under three minutes. Over five point nine million views. And this one is not done with us today.
Number eight, from the United Kingdom, Mat Armstrong MK2, with “ATTEMPTING TO FIX THE MISFIRING BUGATTI CHIRON”. Over forty-two minutes of garage work, and over six point nine million views.
Number seven, from Spain, Miguel ASSAL, with a thirty-seven second survival Short. Over seven point seven million views.
Number six, from Austria, Red Bull, with “Always Keep Going”. Thirty seconds, and over eight million views.

Number five, from Belgium, Blin., with “How to Crack Lucia in GTA 6”. Over eight point six million views, from a channel of about sixty-two thousand subscribers. The first GTA 6 video of the day. Not the last.
Number four, FORMULA 1, with the race highlights of the twenty twenty-six Las Vegas Grand Prix. Over ten point six million views.
And now, the podium. Bronze medal, from the United Kingdom, Mrwhosetheboss, with “Why GTA is a Bigger Deal Than You Think”. Over eleven point four million views.
Silver medal, from Turkey, Mr Spring, with “Did GTA 6 Finally Fix BLOCKED Car Doors?”. Thirty-six seconds, and over nineteen million views. Remember this one.

Drum roll, please. The most viewed video of the week in Europe: SEEDPIT Official, with “Kevin says Seed is TOO SMALL”. A thirty-nine second Short with over twenty-eight million views. Small seed, giant numbers.

Second list: the conversation. The ten most commented videos. At number ten, from Ukraine, Domer Grief, with a Minecraft story over twenty-five minutes long. Over five thousand, four hundred comments.
Number nine, from the United Kingdom, Unknown Player, with “GTA 6: What Actually Happens At IRREDEEMABLE?”. Over five thousand, six hundred comments.
Number eight, from the United Kingdom, Mat Armstrong MK2 and the Bugatti Chiron. Over five thousand, seven hundred comments.
Number seven, Jazzghost, with a video of over two hours and twelve minutes. Over seven thousand, six hundred comments.

Number six, from the United Kingdom, Could You Survive History?, with “GTA 6 Is the Most Expensive Flop Ever Made”. Over seven thousand, nine hundred comments, from a channel of about one thousand, nine hundred subscribers.
Number five, from the United Kingdom, DanTDM, with “This Is Why You Hate GTA 6”. Over seven thousand, nine hundred comments. GTA 6 divides opinions.
Number four, FORMULA 1 and the Las Vegas Grand Prix. Over eight thousand, one hundred comments.
Podium time. Bronze medal, from the United Kingdom, IAmBeanz, with “GTA 6 Feels Like Something's Off...”. Over nine thousand, nine hundred comments, from a channel of about five thousand subscribers.
Silver medal, from France, Ninjaxx, with “La fin du duo”. Over thirteen thousand, four hundred comments.

And here it is. The most commented video of the week in Europe. HYPNOS CR, with a GTA 6 video over thirty minutes long. Over sixteen thousand comments, from just over one hundred and thirty-two thousand views. More comments than likes. That's how you get a community talking.
And the last list: the love. The ten most liked videos. At number ten, from Austria, Red Bull, with “Always Keep Going”. Over one hundred and eight thousand likes.
Number nine, from France, Ninjaxx, with “La fin du duo”. Over one hundred and eight thousand likes.
Number eight, FORMULA 1, with Las Vegas. Over one hundred and thirty-one thousand likes.
Number seven, from the United Kingdom, Mrwhosetheboss. Over one hundred and thirty-two thousand likes.
Number six, SEEDPIT Official, now with “Can Kevin FEED Seed to the BIRDS?”. Over one hundred and forty-four thousand likes and over twenty-three million views.
Number five, from Spain, Miguel ASSAL, with his survival Short. Over one hundred and fifty thousand likes.
Number four, from Belgium, Blin., with “How to Crack Lucia in GTA 6”. Over one hundred and eighty-six thousand likes.
The final podium. Bronze medal, from the United Kingdom, Mat Armstrong MK2 and the Bugatti Chiron. Over one hundred and ninety-seven thousand likes. Three lists, three appearances.
Silver medal, PORTIA AI STORY LITH. Remember number nine in views? Over two hundred and ninety-eight thousand likes. So close to the top. But not quite.

Drum roll, please. The most liked video of the week in Europe comes from Turkey. Mr Spring, with “Did GTA 6 Finally Fix BLOCKED Car Doors?”. Over three hundred and three thousand likes. Silver in views, gold in love.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: the Americas. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Europe every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
